test_title: PYST 19: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A conical vessel has base radius 6 cm and height 20 cm. Water is poured into the vessel until it is 3/4 full. Find the volume (in cm³) of water in the vessel.
solution:
**Given:**

Radius (r) = 6 cm

Height (h) = 20 cm

Fraction filled = 3/4

**Formula used:**

Volume of cone = 1/3 × π × r² × h

**Calculation:**

⇒ Full volume = 1/3 × π × 6 × 6 × 20

⇒ = 1/3 × π × 36 × 20

⇒ = 1/3 × π × 720 = 240π

⇒ 3/4 of 240π = 180π

**∴ Volume of water in the vessel = 180π cm³**
